messages:
zoe (design): quick post-review: three UX nits in the routing policy editor preview: SR announcements on reorder are vague; validation chip isn't keyboard accessible; preview summary isn't announced. @liam @anya
liam (pm): ok can you share repro steps?
zoe (design): repro: Policy > Rules > Preview (compact) > add 5 rules > reorder one > run simulation. VoiceOver/NVDA just say 'list updated' or '5 items'. expected: 'Moved \"Block external\" to position 2' or 'Rule \"Allow internal\" now priority 1'.
anya (frontend): can repro. cause: aria-live region is inside the preview and gets remounted on updates. quick fix: keep a singleton `div[aria-live]` outside the preview and emit concise messages. also make the validation chip a focusable `button` with `aria-describedby` so keyboard users can read full details.
pete (engineer): i'll implement an srAnnouncer util that posts assertive messages for moves and polite for the final summary. debounce moves 200ms to avoid spam, but always emit the final summary like: `Simulation complete — 8 matched, 1 fallback`.
a11y-bot: scan results: failures: 1) .rule-chip contrast 2.8:1 (needs >=4.5:1), 2) live region gets unmounted on preview refresh, 3) drag handle missing aria-label. recommended fixes: bump contrast, keep live region mounted, add `aria-label=\"Drag to reorder\"` + role=button.
liam (pm): creating tickets: INF-4101 sr-announcer + visible preview, INF-4102 chip keyboard + contrast + copy, INF-4103 preview-collapse + focus. target EOD Fri.
zoe (design): small UX ask: add a non-voice "How this reads" toggle in the preview panel that surfaces the last announcement text (short/verbose). helps copywriters iterate without assistive tech.
anya (frontend): can prototype a visible text preview first; TTS later. adding to INF-4101 subtask.
liam (pm): thanks all — please include NVDA + VoiceOver in QA checklist before merge.
